definitions.explanation: An exaggerated appetite or greed for food — the attitude of wanting as much (or as good) food as possible. Usually used with a light, half-joking tone, often about oneself, but can be critical when used of others. Most commonly appears in the set phrase {食|く}い{意地|いじ}が{張|は}る.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}っている→張る：12583_haru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}っていて→張る：12583_haru⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧しまう。
examples.english: He is so greedy for food that he even eats other people's share.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}っていて→張る：12583_haru⟧、⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧。
examples.english: Even though I've started dieting, I'm so greedy when it comes to food that I just can't hold back from sweets.

notes:
Composed of {食|く}い (eating, nominalized form of ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ "to eat") and ⟦{意地|いじ}→意地：01786_iji⟧ (willpower, stubbornness, pride). Literally something like "eating stubbornness." The word is most natural in the fixed expression {食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ ("one's greed for food is extended/stretched"), which means to be greedy about food.

REGISTER:
Informal and conversational. It is often used self-deprecatingly ("I'm such a glutton") and can be affectionate between friends or family. When used about others without a joking tone, it may sound mildly critical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧: to be greedy for food (set phrase)
- {食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{張|は}った→張る：12583_haru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person who is greedy for food
- {食|く}い{意地|いじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: one's greed for food wins out (over willpower)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食|く}いしん{坊|ぼう}→食いしん坊：16180_kuishinbou⟧: a glutton, a "foodie" — more affectionate; often used of children
- ⟦{意地|いじ}→意地：01786_iji⟧⟦{汚|きたな}い→汚い：00788_kitanai⟧: greedy, grasping (not only about food) — harshly critical
- {大食|おおぐ}らい: a big eater — neutral, describes quantity
- ⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧: having a strong appetite — neutral/positive
